verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev ships an official @trigger.dev/sdk (TypeScript/JavaScript, plus Python via build extension) that underpins all task, queue, realtime, and management functionality, with extensive first-party docs and code samples, and community evidence confirms developers build production AI agent workloads directly against it. missing for 10: no official OpenAPI spec or multi-language SDK beyond TS/Python, and no independent third-party SDK quality audit.
